items.title: American Airlines Subsidiary Envoy Compromised in Oracle Hacking Campaign
items.description: Envoy Air, a wholly owned subsidiary of American Airlines, has confirmed it fell victim to a hacking campaign exploiting vulnerabilities in Oracle’s E-Business Suite (EBS). The breach, first highlighted by the notorious Clop ransomware group, underscores the growing risks facing enterprise software in the aviation sector.
